## Personal GTM Engine
Finds B2B startups likely to need GTM automation, picks the right founder, drafts a grounded first message and parks it for human review. Nothing is sent from n8n.

**Run:** manual. Run GTM Contact Finder first when contacts_queue has new rows.
**Reads:** Neon config, Google Sheets, n8n Data Tables.
**Writes:** Sheets (accounts, contacts, queues, ops) and Neon outreach_queue (pending drafts).
**On failure:** GTM Engine: Error Alerts.

Colors: green = free, rule-based · orange = spends credits or calls an LLM · blue = CRM or human step · gray = setup and telemetry

## 1 · Config
Loads the live config version from Neon. Every gate, threshold and switch below is read from it and edited in the review console.

## 2 · Discover
Free sources merged into one stream: seed_accounts, YC directory, HN 'Who is hiring' threads. Apollo is wired but off in config. Each source has its own switch and caps.

## 3 · Gate, score, dedupe
Plain-code gates before any spend: timezone UTC+0 to +4, team size 2 to 150, keyword include/exclude, has a website. Scores 0 to 100 with a written breakdown (min 60). Only new domains pass (seen_accounts ledger). Every drop reason is counted.

## 4 · Website enrichment
Fetches each pending account's homepage, detects GTM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Intercom...) with regex signatures and rescores. No API, no credits.

## 5 · Clay layer
Queues accounts scoring 65+ to clay_queue (max 6 per run). Clay runs by hand, metered by Clay Meter. Returned summaries, signals and triggers are merged back into accounts.

## 6 · Contacts
Accounts with no lookup yet go to contacts_queue for GTM Contact Finder. Founders already found are merged, scored by role and email status, and the account is rescored. New contacts only (seen_contacts ledger).

## 7 · Draft and validate
Pairs each qualified account with its best contact and skips any with a live draft in Neon. The LLM gets facts only. Chain: Groq gpt-oss-120b → Groq qwen → Groq gpt-oss-20b → Gemini → template. A rule validator blocks invented numbers, tools not detected and own-product pitches, with one repair try. Drafts land in Neon as pending.

## 8 · Telemetry
One ops row per run: source counts, gate drops, enrichment, Clay, contacts, drafts, LLM calls and failures. Shown on the console Runs page.
